ent-bram.name: Limping
ent-bram.aiDescription: Bram walks with a heavy limp from a knee that never healed, and every step he takes on the dock makes the boards creak.

ent-odette.name: Sings at Work
ent-odette.playerDescription: The eel-smoker sings as she works.
ent-odette.aiDescription: Odette sings old river songs under her breath whenever her hands are busy.

persona.name: Wren
persona.aiDescription: A traveling mapmaker on the road south.

traits.name: Red Scarf
traits.aiDescription: Wren wears a long red wool scarf wound twice around the neck, and tugs at it when uneasy.
